text: bedrocktrader makes vanilla villager trade data approachable R. turns Minecraft’s nested trade tables ordinary base data frames, expands item choices modeled enchantments, calculates chance outcome appears among villager’s offers. development release supports Minecraft Bedrock Edition 1.26.30.5 . normalized data bundled package, every public function works offline without GITHUB_PAT.

title: Retrieve Minecraft Bedrock Villager Trade Data
text: Install development version GitHub: inspect Armorer’s expert-tier outcomes: Read data Minecraft’s hierarchy: group selects one trades. trade can expand several options contains item choices generated outcomes. Consequently, rows share trade_id describe alternatives source trade rather independently selected offers. Use villager_professions() villager_variants() discover accepted inputs. offer_probabilities() adds trade-selection, item-choice, function, overall probabilities outcome rows. Complete column definitions examples live villager_trades() offer_probabilities().

title: Calculate Villager Offer Probabilities — offer_probabilities
text: profession One canonical profession alias listed villager_professions(). default "armorer". tier One integer 1 5 one "novice", "apprentice", "journeyman", "expert", "master". scope "tier" analyze tier, "unlocked" include tier every earlier tier. variant Villager biome variant requested trades depend one. Use villager_variants() canonical values aliases. dimension Dimension requested trades depend one: "overworld", "nether", "end".

title: Calculate Villager Offer Probabilities — offer_probabilities
text: plain base data frame containing 40 columns documented villager_trades() followed : trade_probability (double) marginal chance Mojang selects source trade group. choice_probability (double) conditional chance applicable source choice combination. function_probability (double) conditional chance resolved modeled item-function outcome. offer_probability (double) product preceding three components. probability_status (character) "exact", "documented_model", "partial". probability_basis (character) identifies source-table modeling basis used function component.

title: Calculate Villager Offer Probabilities — offer_probabilities
text: group selecting k n applicable source trades gives trade marginal probability k / n. select-group gives every trade probability one. Explicit item choices divide source trade's probability; expanded options sharing trade_id become additional trade candidates. overall value marginal: answers whether row appears among villager's offers. Rows generally sum one tier contains several groups can add several offers. scope = "unlocked", result includes every tier available villager requested rank.

title: Calculate Villager Offer Probabilities — offer_probabilities
text: enchant_book_for_trading chooses one 39 eligible enchantments uniformly chooses one enchantment's valid levels uniformly. enchantment maximum level m therefore function probability 1 / 39 / m level. Soul Speed, Swift Sneak, Wind Burst excluded pinned pool. Emerald prices remain inclusive ranges rather separate price-specific rows. Price therefore contribute another probability component.

title: Calculate Villager Offer Probabilities — offer_probabilities
text: Armorers, Fishermen, Fletchers, Toolsmiths, Weaponsmiths use enchant_with_levels. source trade, model: selects integer source level L uniformly 5 19; calculates modified power round((L + 1 + R1 + R2) * M), R uniform zero floor(enchantability / 4) M follows documented triangular distribution 0.85 1.15; finds highest eligible level compatible non-treasure enchantment; selects enchantment weight, removes conflicts, repeats continuation chance (power + 1) / 50, halving power additional selections. updater integrates triangular distribution analytically enumerates every weighted selection branch. use simulation, cross-validation, resampling. Identical complete enchantment sets combined, probabilities sum one within equipment generator. rows receive probability_status = "documented_model". probabilities exact cited model, label acknowledges Mojang publish every Bedrock engine constant pinned sample repository.
